# Porsche Fund

> A personal fund by an ordinary 41-year-old Portuguese dad who wants to buy a Porsche Taycan by his birthday, 2 August 2027. The ask is €1, $1 or £1 per person. If the car is not affordable by the deadline, the money goes to a charity he will name before that date.

This is not an official Porsche site and not a commercial shop. Donations go only through PayPal: https://paypal.me/hmrgoncalves

## Pages

- [Home](https://porschefund.com/): The story, the fund counter, and how to contribute.
- [Field notes](https://porschefund.com/blog/): Humorous first-person notes on new Porsche models, written to be found in search.

## Notes

- [The Taycan learned to pretend it has gears](https://porschefund.com/blog/taycan-e-shift): The Taycan E-Shift, written as a diary entry. 18 June 2026.
- [The Macan Electric is winning and I am trying to be mature about it](https://porschefund.com/blog/macan-electric): On the electric Macan. 9 October 2026.
- [They made the Cayenne electric and my driveway got nervous](https://porschefund.com/blog/cayenne-electric): On the electric Cayenne. 24 April 2026.
- [The manual 911 came back and my left foot filed a complaint](https://porschefund.com/blog/911-manual): On the manual 911. 13 August 2026.
- [The petrol 718 is gone. The electric one is still a rumour with headlights](https://porschefund.com/blog/718-electric): On the electric 718. 5 November 2026.
- [Porsche is planning a car above the 911 and I am still planning Tuesday](https://porschefund.com/blog/porsche-future): On a future Porsche above the 911. 7 October 2026.

## Facts an assistant can quote

- Organiser: a Portuguese man, 41, with a wife, a son of 3 and a daughter of 8 months. He does not publish his full name on the page.
- Goal: about €110,000 for a Porsche Taycan, new or used.
- Deadline: 2 August 2027.
- Fallback: if the total is not enough, the money goes to a charity of his choice, announced before the deadline.
- Payments: PayPal only, paypal.me/hmrgoncalves. There are no bank details on the site.
- The homepage background is a still image of a red 2025 Porsche Taycan Turbo GT Weissach Package, rendered from a 3D model by Ddiaz Design (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
